_comment: The aspects the writer reviews a draft by. The adapter loads this at run time; the workflow graph carries no aspect id, so adding an aspect is a new entry here plus its prompt file, shipped by an image rebuild rather than a workflow edit.
_comment_prompts: Each prompt is a file beside this registry, in the adapter image.

aspects.focus: the plot, the arc and the fit to the shape the writer chose
terms, plain language and depth at the row's audience level
